body.objective: Test whether a symmetry-compatible C/eta structure descends through the selected cylinder BRST/residual complex rather than merely flipping the reduced E/A/L signs.
body.stop_condition: Import the certified cylinder E/A/L carrier, Krein form, D action, residual generators and P2-A contract. Reproduce the obvious C0=+1_E direct-sum -1_A direct-sum -1_L positivity on the reduced carrier, then compute its commutators with every residual generator and BRST/chain map through the declared energy cutoff. Search the full invariant commutant for a corrected C/eta satisfying chain-map descent and positive cohomology; either construct it with exact witnesses or certify the first representation-theoretic obstruction. The known rank-32 proper-conformal commutator is a required regression, not a conclusion to hard-code.
body.forbid: no Q positive-self-adjointness condition; no reduced sign flip called a residual C operator; no finite energy cutoff silently promoted to all energies; no full-BV state or unitarity claim
body.resource_hint: The proper-conformal generators are the first nontrivial compatibility test; retain both chiralities and all declared residual rows.
